parsed.summary: The PR corrects a misleading hint in the error message for recursive relationships, but it does not address the underlying issue of the error itself.

issues.description: The PR only changes the hint in the error message, but it does not address the root cause of the error. The error message still suggests using ForeignKey with symmetrical=False, which is incorrect for recursive relationships with an intermediary model.
The PR does not include any tests to verify that the corrected hint is accurate and does not introduce new issues.
